mapper.sql: id, mistake_note_id, user_id, recall_text, transient_note, suggested_rating, hit_points_json, missed_points_json, gap_summary, ai_suggested, created_at
mapper.select: INSERT INTO review_recall_evaluation ( mistake_note_id, user_id, recall_text, transient_note, suggested_rating, hit_points_json, missed_points_json, gap_summary, ai_suggested, created_at ) VALUES ( #{mistakeNoteId}, #{userId}, #{recallText}, #{transientNote}, #{suggestedRating}, #{hitPointsJson, typeHandler=org.congcong.algomentor.agent.persistence.postgres.json.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{missedPointsJson, typeHandler=org.congcong.algomentor.agent.persistence.postgres.json.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{gapSummary}, #{aiSuggested}, #{createdAt} ) RETURNING
